# KORZAVO MEALS

> KORZAVO MEALS makes fresh, delicious, protein-rich meals for busy professionals, fitness enthusiasts and anyone looking for healthier everyday food. It is the meals sub-brand of Korzavo. Initial launch location: Tauranga, New Zealand. Prices are in NZD and include GST.

## Lunch menu
- VELVET BEEF (520g) NZ$18.90
- KORZAVO FIRE SKEWERS (460g) NZ$18.90
- REDLINE BEEF PASTA (455g) NZ$18.90
- KORZAVO PHOENIX (502g) NZ$18.90
- KORZAVO VOLCANO (540g) NZ$18.90
- HERB GRILLED CHICKEN (510g) NZ$18.90
- CAJUN TIDE (530g) NZ$18.90

## Lunch (NZ$18.90 each) — 5+ lunches get 3 free breakfasts
Choose free Protein Rice Pudding (Strawberry & Vanilla, Tropical Mango, Blueberry & Vanilla) or Protein Oatmeal (Banana & Cinnamon, Chocolate, Pistachio & Honey). Orders of fewer than 5 lunch meals do not include a complimentary breakfast.

## Dinner (NZ$19.90 each) — 3+ dinners get 1 free soup
- CHICKEN BURRITO BOWL
- KORZAVO BEEF WRAP
- BEEF PEPPERONI PIZZA LASAGNA (house special)
- SLOW-COOKED LAMB SHOULDER
- LEMON HERB SHRIMP SKEWERS
Customers build their own dinner plan: any dinners, any quantity per dish. Choose a free Lentil Soup or Pumpkin Soup. Ordering is for people in Tauranga, New Zealand only; anyone can browse.

## Desserts
Order both lunch and dinner meals for the week (5+ lunches and 3+ dinners) and choose 2 free dessert cups (Golden Coconut Bites, Date & Coconut Balls) as an extra bonus.

## Weekly Signature Plan
7 signature meals for NZ$124.90 (seven meals ordered separately: NZ$132.30).
